whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Manorma Cake & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.7★ reviews in Chhoti Pahari, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for birthday cakes and quick delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur instant location navigation integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/manorma

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Manorma Cake & Cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and your menu showcase right opposite S2 Mall in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not]: No problem at all, direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback! Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact products aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain.
